methodology.finding: The method is a structured incremental attribution system with hierarchical constraints and a latent memory bank. The mechanism names come from the saved contribution abstract, not a fresh reading of unseen §4 content.
The work formalizes a decision hierarchy involving real images, known generators and unseen synthetic generators, followed by generator/family attribution.

The protocol specifies class space, schedule, withheld classes and metrics for comparative evaluation; this is a reusable evaluation design, beyond merely using many data sources or showing a large table.
